misconceptions.title: A protected piece is safe
misconceptions.belief: If a piece has a defender, nobody can take it.
misconceptions.truth: A defended piece can still lose material when the attacker is worth less than the piece.
misconceptions.learnerPhrase: A belief that may be costing you games: 'a protected piece is safe'.

misconceptions.title: A check is always a good move
misconceptions.truth: A check that loses the checking piece, or gains nothing, only helps the opponent.
misconceptions.learnerPhrase: A belief that may be costing you games: 'a check is always good'.

misconceptions.title: Always capture when you can
misconceptions.belief: Taking a piece is always right.
misconceptions.truth: Some captures lose to a recapture or a trap. Count before you take.
misconceptions.learnerPhrase: A belief that may be costing you games: 'always capture when you can'.

misconceptions.title: Ignore their last move if my plan is faster
misconceptions.belief: My attack is faster, so their threat can wait.
misconceptions.truth: Their threat usually comes first. Check what they threaten before every move.
misconceptions.learnerPhrase: A belief that may be costing you games: 'my plan is faster than their threat'.

misconceptions.title: Trade anything that is equal
misconceptions.belief: An even trade is always fine.
misconceptions.truth: Trade when you are ahead or when it removes their best piece. Avoid it when it leaves you worse.
misconceptions.learnerPhrase: A belief that may be costing you games: 'any equal trade is fine'.
